title: MaterializedPrism
description:
One prism as a customer reads it: display copy plus the series from its
current published snapshot.

Exactly what the public prisms page renders, out of the same composition,
so an API caller and the page can never show different numbers for the
same prism. Extra keys are allowed through on purpose: the body is the stored snapshot entry with display
fields laid over it, and pinning the shape here would silently drop a new
snapshot key from the API until someone edited this class.

data_through.title: Data Through
data_through.description: Last day of real data in the series. Lags today when upstream sources are behind, so this - not the window end - is what says how current the numbers are.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Per-entity relative series. ``mtd_yoy`` / ``mtd_share`` by day of the latest month with data; ``hist_yoy`` / ``hist_share`` by month over the charted year. Year-over-year index levels and share-of-group percentages only, never absolute figures.
